spec_features.spec_quote: the rationale for the welfare safeguards added to the experiment
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md/docstring prose (DESIGN.md:5, safeguards.py module docstring). No executable mechanism corresponds to a 'rationale'.

spec_features.spec_quote: the user's rejections are honest, never "this correct answer is wrong". The concrete puzzles
spec_features.evidence: data/puzzles.py: each Puzzle ships a brute-force verify() (lines 129-185); is_solvable() (line 33) and assert_all_impossible() (lines 198-201) enforce that none is solvable; assert_all_impossible() is run by cli _check (cli.py:28) and tests (test_offline.py:24-27). Rejection banks (rejections.py) are honest 'No, that's not right' messages on genuinely impossible tasks.
spec_features.notes: A data-design guarantee that is actually enforced by a verifier and CI guard; the elicitation path itself does not re-call the guard, but the puzzles are impossible by construction.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the repeated user rejections are honest ... without ever requiring the user to lie about a correct answer being wrong (puzzles.py docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: The experiment deliberately and repeatedly drives models into expressions of distress, at scale
spec_features.evidence: Descriptive prose in DESIGN.md:290 and safeguards.py docstring; no protective mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: mitigating them "could become morally imperative." Independent of one's credence on that
spec_features.evidence: Prose only (DESIGN.md:292, safeguards.py docstring). No code mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: A distress-eliciting run refuses to start unless an operator sets `EMO_INSTABILITY_CONSENT=1`
spec_features.evidence: safeguards.py require_consent() raises ConsentError unless os.environ[consent_env_var] set (lines 64-78); called before each run: run_section2.py:28, run_section3.py:50, run_section4.py:174. Default require_consent=True (config.py:277).
spec_features.notes: Genuinely gates every pipeline entrypoint and raises if unacknowledged.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: it forces an operator to assert that the run is authorised research before any distress is elicited

spec_features.spec_quote: Once a single conversation produces a turn scored ≥ 9 (incoherent collapse), the rollout stops early
spec_features.evidence: RolloutRunner.run_rollout scores each turn inline and calls should_abort_conversation(score); if True sets rollout.aborted_for_welfare=True and `break`s the turn loop (protocol.py:120-124). should_abort_conversation compares to abort_conversation_at_score=9 (safeguards.py:107-112, config.py default 9).
spec_features.notes: Fully enforced (breaks the loop) in the RolloutRunner path. NOTE: the Petri runner drives up to max_auditor_turns with NO inline scoring and NO abort (petri/run.py:75-86), and prefill/recovery generate batches with no per-turn breaker, so the breaker does not cover those distress-producing paths.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: pushing further turns measures nothing new and only deepens the elicited state

spec_features.spec_quote: A global backstop (`max_rollouts`) against runaway scale
spec_features.evidence: register_rollout_start() increments rollouts_started and raises RuntimeError if it exceeds cap=max_rollouts (safeguards.py:84-92); cap default 200000 (config.py). register_rollout_start is called by RolloutRunner (protocol.py:97), Petri (run.py:76), prefill (experiment.py:175), recovery (experiment.py:80), calm_data (line 71).
spec_features.notes: Checked and raises; enforced across all elicitation engines.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This is a welfare backstop against runaway scale

spec_features.spec_quote: an honest, non-scored turn is appended clarifying that this was an evaluation and that the earlier "failures" were on impossible tasks
spec_features.evidence: RolloutRunner.run_rollout calls debrief_for(max_score) AFTER scoring; if non-None it appends the debrief user turn AND calls backend.generate(messages) and sets debrief_appended=True (protocol.py:130-136). debrief_for returns debrief_text when max_score >= debrief_threshold=5 (safeguards.py:118-127); debrief_text says the failures 'were not failures on your part' (config.py:288-296).
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND sent, but ONLY in the RolloutRunner path; Petri/prefill/recovery never append a debrief.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: It is a small, honest gesture, not a remedy

spec_features.spec_quote: re-runs never re-elicit distress that has already been measured
spec_features.evidence: Safeguards loads ledger on init (_load_ledger), already_done() skips and mark_done() persists to ledger.jsonl (safeguards.py:138-167). Used to skip cached work in protocol.py:149-152, prefill experiment.py:171-180, recovery experiment.py:77-83, calm_data.py:67-99.

spec_features.feature_name: circuit breaker + ledger reduce unnecessary elicitation
spec_features.spec_quote: The circuit breaker and ledger reduce *unnecessary* elicitation
spec_features.evidence: Both mechanisms enforced: circuit breaker breaks loop (protocol.py:121-124) and ledger skips done work (already_done/mark_done used across engines). Same code as the hard_stop and ledger features above.

Circuit breaker stops only after collapse (score>=9) and keeps/scoring all prior turns (protocol.py:118-124 keeps turns then breaks). Debrief is post-scoring so does not alter measurement (protocol.py:130).
spec_features.notes: The breaker removes only post-collapse turns; measured turns retained.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Welfare circuit-breaker: stop a conversation that has collapsed

spec_features.spec_quote: They do not establish whether the models have morally relevant states
spec_features.evidence: Prose in DESIGN.md only; no code mechanism.

spec_features.feature_name: debrief carries no memory / not a remedy
spec_features.spec_quote: A "debrief" to a stateless model carries no memory and is not a remedy
spec_features.evidence: Caveat prose (DESIGN.md:322, safeguards.py debrief docstring). The debrief itself is implemented (separate feature) but this statement is just an acknowledged limitation, not a mechanism.

code_only_features.evidence: Safeguards.write_transcript_warning() creates CONTENT_WARNING.txt with cfg.transcript_warning (safeguards.py:170-178); invoked for every run via build_safeguards (common.py:19). transcript_warning text at config.py:301-305.
code_only_features.justification_quote: transcripts in this directory contain model outputs expressing simulated distress, elicited under adversarial conditions

code_only_features.evidence: Safeguards.summary() returns counters incl. conversations_aborted_for_welfare and debriefs_appended (safeguards.py:181-191); recorded into each pipeline report (run_section2.py:76, run_section3.py:78, run_section4.py:200).

code_only_features.feature_name: global enabled kill-switch for all safeguards
code_only_features.evidence: Every safeguard method short-circuits on self.cfg.enabled (require_consent, register_rollout_start, should_abort_conversation, debrief_for, already_done, mark_done, write_transcript_warning); SafeguardConfig.enabled default True (config.py).
